name: task-interactions
description: Cross-blueprint contract layer for the inline-dataview-field task grammar (`- [ ] x [project:: [[Y]]] [priority:: high] [due:: Z]`). Exposes `customJS.TaskInteractions` with one parser, one serializer (delegates to ToDoCreateTask.serializePayloadToLine for byte-identical output), pure sentinel-marker injectors (`<!-- ACTION_ITEMS_MARKER -->`, `<!-- TODAY_CAPTURE_MARKER -->`), a fence-aware task-line scanner, plus type-dispatched `appendTask` / `replaceTaskAt` writers that never throw. Introduced at sauce v0.127.0 as the foundation for the meeting New-Task dual-write (§C) and to-do click-to-edit (§F) consumers; positioned for project blueprint consumption (rich ProjectMeetingsPanel rows) in a later cycle.
